content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Bitcoin ebook

Gumroad and similar platforms offer a straightforward way to list and sell digital products. However, they charge hefty fees — Gumroad takes 10% on every sale, significantly cutting into your profits. On the other hand, using NOWPayments allows you to accept Bitcoin with just a 0.5% fee, which means you retain more of your earnings. For instance, selling a $97 ebook results in a $9.70 fee with Gumroad, compared to only $0.49 with NOWPayments. Over 100 sales, that fee difference means you keep an additional $921. This stark contrast highlights the financial benefits of choosing a platform that minimizes transaction costs while maximizing your revenue.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and other conventional payment processors often limit access based on geographic location, leaving many creators in developing countries unable to sell. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a solution designed specifically for creators in regions with payment restrictions. By accepting cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, you bypass conventional banking hurdles, allowing you to reach a global audience without the limitations imposed by traditional payment gateways. This architecture empowers you to sell ebooks seamlessly, regardless of your location or the restrictions in place.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, speed is crucial. Gumroad typically takes time to process payments, which can delay your access to funds. In contrast, NOWPayments provides instant payment verification on-chain. This means as soon as a customer pays with Bitcoin, the transaction is confirmed, and you can deliver the ebook immediately. Additionally, with the low fees associated with NOWPayments, your bottom line remains intact. At 100 sales of a $97 ebook, the fee difference translates to $921 retained in your hands, highlighting the immediate financial benefits.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings with NOWPayments versus Gumroad's 90%.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Unlike platforms that control your sales data and product delivery, using a sovereign stack gives you complete ownership. With infrastructures like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of ebooks as soon as payment is confirmed. This setup not only secures your intellectual property but also ensures that you maintain control over your customer data. The automation components handle order processing seamlessly, allowing you to focus on creating rather than managing logistics.

For creators looking to minimize costs and maximize control, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is the optimal choice. It includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Whether you’re selling ebooks, templates, or online courses, this kit equips you with all the blueprints and templates necessary for success. The infrastructure allows you to implement NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions and integrate delivery systems that provide instant access to your customers.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automate your ebook delivery and payment verification in real-time.

This kit provides all the tools needed for a sovereign digital commerce stack, ensuring you can operate independently and profitably.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
